issues.legal_issue: A ginning and pressing factory forming an operational and administrative part of a textile undertaking may be treated as part of that undertaking for a takeover of its management.
material_facts: The cotton processed in the ginning and pressing factory was used in the textile mill.
The factory and the mill were under common supervision and control.
The salaries of workers in both operations were paid from the same account.
They shared an administrative office and clerical staff.
The company's accounts separately listed assets for the mill and the ginning and pressing factory, and the two operations had separate provident fund schemes.
issues.conclusion: The ginning and pressing factory was part and parcel of the textile undertaking, so its takeover along with the undertaking was valid; the writ petition was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Whether an operation is a distinct establishment or part of a textile undertaking is assessed from the facts showing its operational and administrative relationship with the undertaking. Separate asset valuations and separate provident fund schemes, without more, do not establish that an operation is a distinct establishment. Section 4(3) of the Sick Textile Undertakings (Taking Over of Management) Act was noted as appearing broad enough to cover property owned by the textile company, but the Court expressly left the reach of that provision undecided. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: writ_challenge_to_takeover and cotton_used_in_mill and common_supervision_and_control and shared_payroll and shared_administration

predicates.writ_challenge_to_takeover: The proceeding challenges the takeover of an operation along with a textile undertaking.
predicates.cotton_used_in_mill: The textile mill used cotton processed in the associated ginning and pressing operation.
predicates.common_supervision_and_control: The mill and the associated operation were subject to common supervision and control.
predicates.shared_payroll: Workers in the mill and the associated operation were paid from the same account.
predicates.shared_administration: The mill and the associated operation shared administrative and clerical resources.

issues.definition: When a takeover challenge concerns an operation whose processed material is used in the mill and which shares supervision, payroll, and administration with it, the operation is treated as part of the undertaking and its takeover with the undertaking is valid.
